incidents.summary: Burberry disclosed destroying £28.6 million of finished goods in the financial year ending March 2018, following approximately £90 million of destruction over five years, and subsequently announced an end to the practice.

sources.title: Why Burberry Burned £28 Million of Its Own Stock On Purpose
sources.quote: Burberry Group plc disclosed in a single line of its annual report that £28.6 million of finished goods had been physically destroyed in twelve months, including £10.4 million of beauty inventory.

sources.title: Why Burberry Burned £28 Million of Its Own Stock On Purpose
sources.quote: Cumulative destruction over the previous five years totalled approximately £90 million.

sources.title: Why Burberry Burned £28 Million of Its Own Stock On Purpose
sources.quote: By September, Burberry had announced the practice was over.

positives: Burberry committed to paying all staff globally during coronavirus-related closures without using Britain's government support scheme.
